Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.
Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.
Liam Neeson stars as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor.
John Hurt shines as a doomed rebel in this stunning film adaptation of George Orwell's classic novel.
A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.
The animals of a zoo break their code of silence...to teach their beloved zookeeper the rules of courtship!
An uptight cop tries to protect the widow of a drug boss as they are pursued across Texas!
A gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles.
Christian Bale delivers a powerful performance as pilot Dieter Dengler, a prisoner in the Vietnam war.
When murder victims are discovered in Russia's Gorky Park, detective William Hurt is on the case and finds himself in a web of political treachery.
This riveting tale sees a British publisher and a Russian editor sucked into the dangerous world of espionage.
This powerful and provocative film explores the consequences war...and of taking a stand!
Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars in this drama about a single mother and her son.
A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.
A judge (Spencer Tracy) presides over the trial of four German jurists accused of "legalizing" Nazi atrocities
Burt Lancaster stars as Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz.
A traveling salesman discovers he can hustle money in a Evangelical tent-show as easily as in a saloon.
An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval
A con man and a naïve hustler from Texas try to survive on the unforgiving streets of New York.
Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.

Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.

From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.
The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.
As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.
An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programmes.t: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programmes.d: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!
In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.
Vincent Price buries his disfigured brother alive, but the body is dug up by a doctor (Christopher Lee). Still alive, the brother seeks his revenge.
A scientist commits a series of murders in his quest to create a race of super humans. Vincent Price, Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing star.
Horror legend Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that turns humans into vampire-like zombies...and his life into an endless nightmare!
Unaware the entire citizenry has been replaced by aliens, a professor arrives in a Midwestern town looking for his ex-wife who vanished.
In this thrilling creature feature, a young boy’s life is turned upside-down when alien invaders intent on taking over the world land in his backyard!

Under cover of darkness, while an unsuspecting city sleeps, an alien life form begins to sow the seeds of unspeakable terror. Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Leonard Nimoy, Veronica Cartwright & Jeff Goldblum star in this classic suspense thriller.

Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.
When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.
Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!
Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!
It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel
When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.
Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.
Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.
Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.
Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.
How fascia, light, water, and emotion form the body's true intelligence and why nature disconnection drives disease.
How one woman defied a terminal diagnosis through radical inner work, proving consciousness directs biology and healing begins when we remember our power.
Why your wellness routines might be avoidance and how seeing the invisible lens shaping your reality is the only true path to freedom.
Did you know being active in the gym could improve your activity in the bedroom? Everything you wanted to ask about sex but didn’t. Now you can on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.
A man gets terrible headaches right at the height of passion. And a woman won’t talk about her sexual desires. What should her partner do? All this and more on Sex Talk with Dr. Lia.

Today Lisa talks with Kim Chestney, the author of Radical Intuition: A Revolutionary Guide to Using Your Inner Power. A globally recognized innovation leader and the founder of Intuition Lab, her work has been featured or supported by leading-edge organizations including SXSW Interactive and Carnegie Mellon University. Info: KimChestney.com.

Lisa Garr talks with Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned pediatrician, who speaks about his book “No Regrets Living” which outlines keys to living a life of wonder & contentment including self-forgiveness, opening to miracles, & discovery.

Lisa Garr talks with Fast Company Senior writer Nicole LaPorte. She researched the divide between the haves & have-nots including examining the vicious competitiveness of college admissions, bribes & lack of ethics within certain departments.

Lisa Garr talks with best-selling author and spiritual teacher Anita Moorjani, who discusses life as an empath. Her latest book is “Sensitive is the New Strong,” which talks about the importance of having boundaries, especially as an empathic person.

Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

En el norte de Sudamérica existe un enorme territorio de llanuras interminables que cambia su aspecto dos veces al año: a veces inundado aparentemente hasta el infinito, otras casi desecado.
Tras muchos kilómetros recorridos, el río cambia el paisaje. En sus meandros abandonados se multiplican las especies.
Son los grandes almacenes de la naturaleza. La base de todo son las pequeñas algas, dieta de numerosos moluscos, insectos, crustáceos y peces.
En el Estado de California crecen algunos de los bosques más notables del planeta por su magnitud, su diversidad y por la dimensión gigantesca de sus árboles.
Uno de los ecosistemas más raros del planeta es el Bosque Espinoso de Madagascar donde casi todas las plantas cuentas con espinas como puñales.

Sueños de éxito transformados en pesadillas. Inversiones millonarias en franquicias prometedoras que se desmoronan bajo la corrupción y las mentiras. Desde jardines infantiles hasta centros de estética, historias de fraude y desesperación emergen.

Edgar Vallejo, desaparecido en diciembre de 2022, dejó una carta de advertencia a su hija, revelando que saldría con su hermano José Miguel. Tras investigaciones, se descubrió su trágico paradero, el motivo, sus bienes inmuebles y su dinero.

Entre 1999 y 2003, Manuel Octavio Bermúdez, “el monstruo de los cañaduzales”, asesinó a 18 niños en el Valle del Cauca. Fue capturado tras el testimonio de un sobreviviente y condenado en 2004 a 25 años de prisión por abuso y homicidio serial.

La periodista Flor Alba Núñez fue asesinada en 2015 en Pitalito. “El Loco” y “El Chori” fueron condenados por el crimen. Se cree que su muerte estuvo ligada a denuncias periodísticas, incluyendo corrupción política y otros hechos locales.

Una mujer que tiene la capacidad de engañar sus tres ex esposos y asesinarlos. Estos tres hombres encuentran un destino fatal cuando caen en las redes del amor de Esneda, pero ninguno de ellos conoció las verdaderas intenciones que se escondían tras la atractiva y convincente mujer, sometiendo la voluntad de ellos a quienes convirtió en sus aparentes maridos, con el único objetivo de cobrar un seguro de vida donde ella era le beneficiaria.

En 2014, en Medellín, Luis Felipe Muñoz Masías, de 16 años, fue asesinado por su propio padrino, Jesús Giraldo, quien lo sometía a abuso sexual desde hacía años. En un ataque de celos, Giraldo lo atacó con un arma contundente causándole la muerte. La investigación reveló una historia de obsesión y esclavitud sexual. Giraldo enfrenta cargos por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento a menor.

Alfredo Padilla mantenía relaciones con las hermanas Wendy y Karime Gómez sin que ninguna lo supiera. Tras su desaparición, la policía halló su cuerpo enterrado en la casa de las hermanas. Wendy confesó haberlo envenenado y contratado a un obrero para enterrarlo. Fue condenada a 20 años de cárcel por homicidio agravado, mientras Karime enfrenta un proceso judicial para probar su inocencia.

Katherin desapareció el 15 de mayo de 2017 tras viajar a Bucaramanga. Su ex, un militar llamado Elisaldo Aguilar, no aceptó el fin de la relación y usó una millonaria propuesta como trampa para asesinarla.
El alemán Cristian se enamora de Yesmid en Armero Guayabal y forma una familia. Años después, ella planea su asesinato con sicarios, buscando quedarse con su fortuna.

Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

Marlén Calderón fue entregada por su abuela a los 6 años con la promesa de un hogar, pero terminó esclavizada como empleada doméstica en Bogotá, víctima del tráfico humano. Tras años de maltrato y trabajo forzado, logró rehacer su vida. Décadas después, su hermana Andrea la encontró a través de una foto en redes sociales, y juntas se reencontraron tras años de búsqueda y dolor.

Elena Sada, sobreviviente de los Legionarios de Cristo, revela en 'Los Informantes' el abuso sistemático del padre Marcial Maciel, quien victimizó a decenas de niños. Durante 20 años, Sada vivió privada de libertad dentro de la secta, incluso reclutando nuevos miembros, hasta escapar y reconstruir su vida. Hoy narra su testimonio en el libro 'El ave negra', exponiendo décadas de encubrimiento eclesiástico.

En el episodio de hoy de MAURY, Maurio dice que no es padre de 5 niños. Cuando los cinco análisis se revelen, ¿se demostrará que tiene razón o que es un perdedor por cinco veces? ¡La familia de Jon dice que no es el padre del bebé de Courtney! ¿Los resultados de los análisis dirán lo contrario?

Centavia sospecha que su novio Richard la engaña con Kheisha, la niñera. Después, Kristy le revelará 2 secretos a su novio Matt que podrían terminar su relación. ¡Descubre estos secretos impactantes hoy!

Kendra tiene la misión de salvarla de su novio tóxico Chris. A los 17 años, Kendra está embarazada de su sexto hijo. Kendra lo ha intentado casi todo, incluso echarlo de su casa, pero no solamente se defendió, sino que también golpeó a Kendra.

Deshawn afirma que su ex Lynette abandonó a su hijo de 5 años. Pero ella afirma que él la está alejando de su hijo. Sin embargo, Deshawn se enteró recientemente de que no está en el certificado de nacimiento de su hijo, ¡así que quiere una prueba de ADN!

El 27 de abril de 2011, un tornado azotó Tuscaloosa, Alabama, causando daños masivos y víctimas. La hija de Toye, Latoya, fue reportada como desaparecida, pero la policía la investigó como homicidio. ¿Tuvo Toye algo que ver con su desaparición?

La novia de Nick descubre por qué él pasa tanto tiempo con su vecina; el novio de Osha tiene una aventura con su amiga; Brandi resiente el comportamiento imprudente de su novio después de todos los sacrificios que ha hecho para mantener su relación.
La nueva novia de Barin tiene un secreto; Ericka desaprueba a la novia de su hermana; otro hombre puede arruinar la boda de Tyler.

Carl ha venido a decirle a su novia que se ha estado acostando con su peor enemiga, Keisha. A continuación, Donte le dirá a su mejor amigo, Quincy, que está acostándose con su prometida. Después, Janel y Nikkie están peleando por el mismo hombre.
Una mujer encuentra un romance con la hermana gemela de su prometido; un hombre recurre a otra mujer en busca de atención; un hombre le dice a la madre de su hijo que quiere estar con otra persona.

El marido de Darleen dice que es adicto a los clubes de striptease; el novio de Mary está obsesionado con limpiar su coche, y ella sospecha que lo está usando como tapadera para algo más; el miedo de Jesse al compromiso lo mete en problemas.

Jhon Ferney, condenado por feminicidio en 2015, muestra los efectos de la celopatía, trastorno originado en la infancia por la falta de afecto. Su historia revela cómo los celos enfermizos y una relación tóxica desembocaron en tragedia.

Un productor de Séptimo Día graba cómo en un bar en Bucaramanga se alquilan niños para mendicidad. Yiriam y Franklin, migrantes venezolanos, pierden a su hija menor tras dejarla al cuidado de Franyeli, quien es detenida por mendicidad ajena. La Policía y el ICBF intervienen en varios casos similares.

Un hombre respetado por la sociedad y admirado como cristiano ejemplar oculta su rostro de agresor dentro de su hogar. Cuando su esposa desaparece, su familia inicia una lucha desesperada por descubrir la verdad detrás de su fachada intachable.

Los ataques de perros peligrosos a niños aumentan en Colombia. Aunque existen leyes, muchos dueños siguen sin responsabilizarse. Las víctimas enfrentan lesiones graves, y las autoridades luchan contra la impunidad, mientras los ataques continúan.

Jhon Fredy y Miguel Ángel adoptaron una niña, pero el Colegio Americano de Bogotá los rechazó por ser una familia homoparental. Fabio Meneses y Xiomy Díaz sufrieron en terapias de conversión. Andrés Felipe Arboleda fue asesinado por discriminación en Caldas.

Estafas de vehículos usados en Colombia afectan a numerosos compradores. Desde autos embargados hasta ventas de vehículos robados, los casos incluyen varios imputados, como Norman Eduardo Serrano y Óscar Fabián Rodríguez.
El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

En 2009, Islanis fue asesinada a los 21 años. El principal sospechoso, alias "Betún", reveló que el verdadero autor intelectual era Jonatán Pérez, un cabo del Ejército, quien la mató al enterarse de su embarazo, temiendo el impacto en su carrera militar. En 2011, Pérez fue condenado a 40 años de prisión por homicidio agravado.

EL caso de un asesinato planeado por una pareja, para quitar del medio a un humilde carpintero con el objetivo quedarse con su fortuna. Hoy los hijos, del ahora difunto, exigen justicia para que los verdaderos culpables paguen las consecuencias de sus actos.

En Cajamarca, Tolima, el líder ambientalista César García fue asesinado frente a su familia tras oponerse a la minera AngloGold Ashanti. Aunque se sospechó de un vínculo con la empresa, las autoridades lo descartaron. Una carta de suicidio reveló que el verdadero autor fue Álvaro Meléndez, vecino con quien García tuvo un litigio de tierras. Meléndez permanece detenido esperando juicio.
Gina Paola Manrique, empresaria de Neiva, fue hallada muerta en un aparente suicidio. Tras investigar, el CTI determinó que fue feminicidio.

Melany Amaya, de 16 años, desapareció tras asistir a una fiesta electrónica en Medellín en junio de 2018. Tras siete días de búsqueda, una llamada anónima alertó a su madre. Su cuerpo fue hallado en un potrero del sector "El Calvario".
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

A los 16 años, Liliana Cáceres se hizo famosa en Barranquilla al fingir un embarazo de nueve bebés, tras enterarse de la infidelidad de su novio con su mejor amiga. Su mentira, que incluso llegó a oídos de Gabriel García Márquez, se descubrió al someterse a exámenes médicos. Tras el escándalo, huyó a Cartagena, rehízo su vida y hoy sueña con ayudar a niñas embarazadas de verdad.

Cinco años después del homicidio de Alonso Orjuela, dueño de Surtifruver, su exesposa Cecilia Rueda y su socio Mauricio Parra hablan por primera vez ante cámaras. Ambos estuvieron presos —ella acusada de complicidad, él de ser testaferro de las FARC— pero fueron liberados por vencimiento de términos. Ahora denuncian un montaje judicial y afirman tener pruebas de que no fue un crimen pasional.
Diamond asegura que SP le rogó un hijo, Jenell dice que él quería otro con ella, pero SP lo niega todo. ¿Debe Tone $3,000 en manutención? ¿Es Jacob el padre del hijo de Tyler y Matina? ¡Hoy en MAURY!

¡Cartel se niega a creer que una aventura de una noche con una amiga de la escuela secundaria, Brittany, resultó en su embarazo! Entonces, ¿Juan y Clinton son los papás de sus hijos? Además, ¡Kelly necesita saber qué primo fue el padre de su bebé!

En el episodio de hoy de MAURY, estos hombres dicen que saben que la prueba de paternidad demostrará lo que siempre han sabido: que no son padres de los hijos de las mujeres que los trajeron aquí. ¡Ellas están listas para demostrarles que están equivocados!

Sherry fue atacada a los 15 años y se escapó de su casa. Quiere que Steve la ayude a reunirse con su madre. Después, la hija adolescente de Dawn, Cathy, dio a luz recientemente, pero vive asustada por el desempleado e inestable padre del bebé, Nick.
Morgan dejó de ser animadora tras el acoso por una foto manipulada; ella y su madre confrontan a los culpables. Luego, Kedrick acusa a Sonya de infidelidad pocos meses después de iniciar su relación.
Connie busca la ayuda de Steve para evitar que su hija Angel se case con Matt, a quien acusa de golpearla y causarle graves lesiones. ¿Logrará convencerla de dejar esta relación abusiva?

Uncover new science topics and discoveries in the fourth episode of SciShow!
Experience the cosmic dance of changing orbits that leads to the birth of a new star.
Venture into the future of human space exploration.
Early online video had low resolution, tiny frames, and buffering, until one breakthrough changed everything.
In 1841 on Réunion, a 12-year-old slave first artificially pollinated the vanilla plant.
Edison pioneered the world’s first research and development center in Menlo Park, New Jersey.
When first presented with the “awesome button,” Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg simply responded: “No.”
Futuristic designer Robert Propst envisioned The Action Office, a workspace to unlock workers’ potential.
Barcodes transformed global commerce, fueling the growth of giants like Walmart and economies like China.
In the 1920s, real estate boosters turned Florida from a backwater into a popular vacation hotspot.
In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created the first synthetic dye, a strange rich purple substance.

Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave, masking other injuries. Dr Mya and Dr Matt fear a young tradie could have a life-altering spinal injury after a fall at work. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.

Paramedics work around the clock fighting to save lives. A do-it-yourself loving handyman gets himself into trouble when he tumbles off a three-metre ladder. With no memory, the brave patient may have a brain bleed. Steve and Emily are ready for anything as an office worker is hot and dizzy, and down to his undies. Babysitting duties turn into a nightmare for a terrified grandmother. Eamon is unimpressed with Mike’s fashion sense, and a former grave digger laughs in the face of death.

Exclusive cameras capture the extraordinary work of emergency service heroes. Steve races to remote bushland where a huge tree has fallen and crushed a man’s leg. Cullen takes drastic action to save a patient whose body is shutting down. Cam and Al bend the rules to lift the spirits of a nine-year-old boy after a frightening asthma attack. Homesick Emily ‘adopts’ a Nanna for the day, when she and Steve help a much-loved grandmother and a terrified daughter watches her Mum fight for life.

MICA paramedic Steve is forced to deploy a high-risk procedure to save a man whose heart is beating out of control. With his distressed family watching on, there are no guarantees the drastic treatment will work. Flight paramedic Ray fears the worst when a young woman crashes through her car’s rear window and smashes onto the road. It’s party time ahead of Leonard’s last shift with his great friend Nat but they will be confronted with one last challenge before an emotional goodbye.

Paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. A terrifying home invasion shocks Mike and Eamon. Despite his own terrible injuries, the victim is desperately worried about his elderly mother. Taz and Amanda take care of a seriously ill little girl whose every day of survival is a miracle. Flight paramedic Ray struggles to understand a bizarre chain of events that began with a stranger knocking at the door in the middle of the night and ended in a house fire.

At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, trauma patients arrive around the clock for urgent care. Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson fear for a pregnant woman injured in a high-speed traffic accident. Doctors Andrew Wallace and Jana Alexander urgently treat a jockey who was crushed under a horse. Doctor Jason Gabriel-Anyassor’s patient is in agony after crashing into a truck. Dr Martin Dutch and Nurse Sarah Thomas resort to translator apps to communicate with a scared young tourist hit by a car.

It’s Manic Monday at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as trauma patients pour in. Dr George Plunkett and Nurse Sarah Thomas worry a motorbike rider could lose his leg. Doctor Glenn Harrison fears a tradie, crushed under 300 kilos of cement, has brain injuries. Drs Emma West and Mya Cubitt celebrate Dr Jana Alexander’s return from maternity leave with cake, then Dr Mya and Dr Jana diagnose a ‘healthy’ man with a ticking time bomb. Dr Emma investigates a pregnant woman’s chest and leg pains.

Lives hang in the balance at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. Dr Mark Putland and the Trauma team have minutes to save a truck driver’s severed leg. Drs Andrew Trezise and Emma West search for neck injuries on a cyclist who’s collided with a van. Then Nurse Eliza Burke notices a red flag. Drs Michael Conboy and Steve Pincus struggle to relocate a student’s jaw after he yawned. Dr Andrew Wallace and Nurse Chelsea Jones fear a champion horse rider might be paralysed after a hard fall.

For 175 years, the Royal Melbourne Hospital has rescued people having their worst day. Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Nurse Susan Hartman keeps the man completely still, but soon his breathing fails. Doctor Jonathan Papson shares nicknames he’s earned at work, but it’s J-Paps medical skills that a power-boat racer needs after a spectacular high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey needs help to reset a dislocated shoulder.

It’s training day at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as Doctors Emma West and Jonathan Papson run new doctors through their paces with make-believe trauma patients. Playtime is soon over as Drs Jonathan and Emmanuel Karpathakis examine a cyclist with glass stuck in his neck. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Michelle Thornhill and Dr Martin Dutch struggle to get oxygen into a young mother having seizures. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency department creates a puzzle for Dr Jonathan Papson: a teenage rugby player who received a hard tackle seems uninjured, so why is he struggling to breathe? Dr Terry Kane, who came to Australia on a whim, faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones also fears his forgetfulness might not be from painkillers but a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.

At the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department, Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West’s friendly chat about peaches is quickly dropped as they treat a mechanic who could lose his crushed arm. Drs Michael Dunn and Mark Putland rally the team to save a truck driver who blacked out and smashed his semi-trailer into a tree. Dr Luke De La Rue’s decision not to ride his bike in the city is reinforced when treating a cyclist with a horrifically mangled ankle after being hit by a car.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Andrew Trezise worries a young dirt bike rider has life-altering injuries after a crash. The rider rolled a truck only the week before. The phone doesn’t stop ringing for Nurse Gunnar Petersen as patients pour in. Dr Jonathan Papson examines a showjumper in agony with multiple breaks after being thrown off a horse. Dr Michael Dunne and Nurse Ebony-Lee Butterworth look for hidden injuries in a stoic tradie who has fallen 3 metres off a roof.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Doctor Jonathan Papson arrives fresh from a family emergency after his daughter’s car broke down with his staff card in it. Moments later, he discovers devastating news for an injured ute driver. Dr Tsung Chung cuts short his favourite meal - peanut butter and jam sandwiches - to help a woman in agony after a high-speed crash. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

Trauma patients arrive day and night to The Royal Melbourne Hospital. The moment Dr Jonathan Papson hears ‘motorbike’, he prepares for multiple injuries and a world of pain for his next patient. Later, he’s impressed with a mechanic’s pain tolerance after he was crushed under a ute when the jack gave way. Dr Andrew Wallace shows off his ‘fugly’ shoes and colourful socks before seeing his next patient who has a punctured lung and broken pelvis from a bicycle crash.

Every eleven seconds a cry for help comes through to emergency services. Flight paramedic Steve heads to the country after a tractor topples over and crushes a farmer. Taz and new teammate Erika hope for the best and prepare for the worst as a much-loved grandma collapses at home. A woman having multiple seizures has Michaela and Simon on high alert. The mother of two’s life is in their hands as she can’t breathe for herself. Steve and Jade’s patient has severe pain, but what’s causing it?

Alarm bells ring for Michaela, as a super-fit dad suddenly has slurred speech. Father-daughter team Brett and Teagan finally work together. They’re shocked by the deep gash on a woman’s leg after tumbling downstairs. Eamon and Mike are teaming up again, helping an elderly asthmatic man who can’t stop coughing. Veterans Doddsy and Andrew’s day is upended as they race to a motorcyclist crash victim with extensive injuries. A six-month-old baby gives Leonard and Cullen a huge scare.

Cam is confronted with carnage after a motorcyclist crashes into parked cars in a suburban street. The treatment Cam needs to perform could go horribly wrong, but without it, the patient will stop breathing. New partners Jodie and Nathan rush to an overheated triathlete who collapses over the finish line. Steve and the flight crew hold a rural GP’s life in their hands. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stoic 96-year-old is downplaying her symptoms as they look for signs of a ‘silent heart attack’.

Nicola and Risky have a quick catch up before it’s straight back to work, treating a disoriented driver who’s had a seizure and crashed her car. Mike and Eamon get all the red flags while treating a mother who’s having a stroke. Simon and Michaela work in cramped conditions, extracting an unconscious young man who’s collapsed at work and is unresponsive. Jodie and Nathan need police help to stay safe while tending an upset patient who’s putting himself and others in danger.

In Victoria, a cry for help comes to emergency services every eleven seconds. Newly-minted MICA paramedic Leonard needs all his skills to help a karate student make it back from the brink of a cardiac arrest. Taz and Erika’s fragile patient starts to come good, then deteriorates fast in the ambulance. Flight paramedic Steve and the team respond to a horrific crash, where a single mum has gone off a bridge and landed into a river. Cam races to a young man with mysterious abdominal pain.

Simon and Michaela mentor a new paramedic in high-demand hands-on revival skills after a young man takes a heroin overdose. Mike and Eamon worry a teen could have life-changing head injuries after a fall and seizure at school. Nicola and Risky check an older driver for spinal fractures after a crash leaves him in agony, and he feels every bump on the way to hospital. Steve and Jade deliver essential care for an incredible woman whose deteriorating health is on a knife edge.

An elite team is ready to save people having their worst day. Alarm bells ring for Cam and Doddsy after a healthy man collapses having multiple seizures. Jade is impressed with Steve’s skills as they support a scared patient who’s struggling to breathe with suspected Covid. Leonard and Cullen attempt a trick-move to stop a woman’s heart from racing. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stressed-out fraud victim could be having a heart attack.

Flight Paramedic Steve worries a teen motorbike rider could lose his leg, after a high-speed crash. MICA Matt faces a grim scenario, as a dearly loved great grandfather’s lung collapses. Taz and Erica are on high alert, when a drug-affected woman wanders onto the street. Father and daughter team Brett and Teagan have a gut-wrenching situation as a mother can’t wake her seven-year-old child. Mike and Eamon rush to a man who collapses in a pizza restaurant before his meal arrives.

Steve and Jade carry a top range of painkillers, but their motorbike crash victim won’t take any. Traffic slows Simon and Michaela as they race to a heart attack survivor drifting in and out of consciousness. Single-responder Jodie’s chest-pain patient has an alarming medical history. Marlie and Tanie’s elderly patient is in agony from a fall and can’t explain what’s happened. Father-Daughter team Teagan and Brett are called to a potential heart attack, but their patient is only in his teens.

MICA paramedics Nathan and Jodie patch up a dirtbike rider who’s fallen five metres and landed on his bum. A suburban shooting has Cam and Al battling to save a young man’s life. He’s in critical condition with an open chest wound. Risky and Nicola are super-impressed with a spritely but unsteady 92-year-old. A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

The Royal Melbourne Emergency Department is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines what’s left of a limestone quarry worker’s arm after it was mangled in a machine. Dr Assiya Halid checks a man for broken and dislocated bones after he collided with a car on his way to a date. Dr Jonathan Papson works carefully to remove a screw from a man’s thumb after a home DIY mishap. Dr Luke de la Rue fears for an unborn baby after a 30-week pregnant mother was hit by a bus.

The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department is ready to help people on their worst days. Dr Emma West fears a motor-cross rider has life-changing injuries after coming off her bike. Time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young farmer’s severely dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off. Dr Mya Cubitt treats a cheerful 103-year-old legend’s leg for a nasty infection.

At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Michael Dunne and Dr Jonathan Papson urgently need answers for one of the sickest patients they’ve seen. The 47-year-old man can’t breathe with suspected pneumonia, but something else is going on. A woman in severe back pain after slipping on concrete at work can’t feel anything when Dr Ilya Kardailsky prods her side with a needle. Dr Michelle Thornhill examines a teenager in agony after he fell five metres onto his back while riding a dirt bike.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Tinnie Chang and Caitlin Young fear a cyclist has potentially life-changing injuries. The man is in intense pain with protruding broken bones after he collided with a ute. Doctors Terry Kane and Bjorn Makein see warning signs when they examine a 30-year-old man with severe chest pain who has a history of collapsed lungs. Dr Emma West suspects a happy older man is hiding his injuries after a motorbike crash, but scans reveal the truth.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s ED, doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West struggle to remove a glove that’s embedded in a construction worker’s mangled hand. Dr Tristan Harding and nurse Tanya Wallace carefully check the spine of a man in agony after he fell off a roof. Dr Assiya Halid examines the shocking injuries of a driver who smashed his lovingly restored car into a wall. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey and Dr Jana Alexander delicately remove something painful from a woman’s ear.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Dr Emma West is on high alert treating a woman’s life-threatening injuries from a car accident. Dr Sarah Whitelaw isn’t sure what she’ll find under the bandages on a man whose foot was slashed by a lawn mower blade. Dr Jonathan Papson prepares for the worst after a paraglider, who is also a nurse, fell 30 metres and landed on his head. Dr Tsung Chung guides Junior Dr Norah O’Sullivan as she checks on a man who’s vomiting blood.

At The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency Department, Drs Bec Hughes and Fahad “Faz” Yousif look after a man who fell off a ladder while pruning his lemon tree and landed on his back. Dr James Williams fears for a young cheerleader who landed on her head during training. Dr Michael Dunne expects the worst when he unwraps the blood-soaked bandages from a man’s arm after it was mangled in a car accident. Dr Jonathan Papson admires a festival goer’s mohawk as he fixes his shoulder.

The Emergency Department at The Royal Melbourne Hospital handles traumas of all kinds. Dr Emma West is on high alert for a cyclist who’s been trapped under a tram. A 21-year-old with a history of sinus issues is bleeding profusely from the back of his throat, and Dr Jonathan Papson worries he could choke. Dr Michelle Thornhill fears an older man might lose his independence after he fell off a roof. Dr David Sparkhall and Dr Michael Dunne treat a motorbike rider with a badly smashed-up knee.

A young woman arrives via helicopter to the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department after her car slammed into a tree. Dr Jonathan Papson worries she’ll have life-changing injuries as her old car lacked modern safety features. Dr David Sparkhall fears the worst as he takes the tourniquet off a handyman’s blood-soaked arm. Dr Tristan Harding expects to find multiple injuries in a man who’s fallen three metres off a balcony. Dr Emma West calms a young mum who’s cut though her hand.

Identidad, percepción y mantener la compostura en público.

El amor, la lujuria y las risas ocupan un lugar central.
Tres comediantes encuentran humor en el hecho de crecer siendo queer.
Sueños, empleos convencionales y llevar tu ser íntegro al trabajo.
Sexo, género, envejecimiento y, sin duda, nada de hablar en voz baja.
Tres comediantes señalan los absurdos de la vida con un humor incisivo y sin complejos, de carácter queer.
Amigos, coqueteos y familia elegida convierten cada salida en una historia.

Teams from across the UK enter the arena in hopes of besting the house robots and making it to the Grand Final. The knockouts keep on coming as eight more competitors think they have what it takes to survive the Robot Wars.
Eight fresh competitors ready to prove their mettle in the arena. Featuring a special event, Middleweight Melee, a single exhibition battle between five robots weighing under 45.4kg.
As the knockouts continue to streamline the competition, this week’s special has separate competitors trying to knock-down objects and hit targets to score the most points in Pinball Warriors.

Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.
This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.
The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.
Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.
Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.
More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.
This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.
The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.

Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.

Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.

Doc Martin's medical career is still under scrutiny because of his pre-existing blood phobia, and he has to pass three new courses; Louisa focuses on her new career.

Mrs. Tishell's young cousin shadows her at the pharmacy for some work experience; Al decides to move in with Morwenna; Angela visits Martin's surgery and notices something wrong with Buddy.

Bakers from San Antonio, Texas, Hamilton Square, New Jersey and Minneapolis, Minnesota compete in a speedy elimination round with Canday Cane as the mystery ingredient. The last two standing compete for $10,000 in a Toy Shop-themed Cupcake Showdown.The Winner advances to the Holiday Championship Finale. With judges Lorraine Pascale, Jeff Mahin and Laura Vitale

Diana goes Japanese: starting with her recipe for ‘Okonomiyaki’,  created using ingredients found in your fridge and pantry. Next stop is meeting owner and chef at Mr. Miyagi, a popular Melbourne restaurant that has a new take on traditional Japanese food. Cooking together with chef Daisuke Miyake (Shinoki restaurant) and finishing up with her own version of ‘Nasu Dengaku’ or miso baked eggplant, to celebrate iconic Japanese umami flavour.

Diana decides to focus on the foods of Northern India. Inspired by heavy curries and fragrant spices, Diana cooks a traditional ‘Lamb Korma’. Prominent chef Adam D'Sylva (Tonka and Coda) shares his ‘Bengali Fish Curry’, a lighter dish. For something sweet, Diana cooks a rice pudding with fragrant northern Indian spices called ‘Kheer’.

A home cook introduces the Wall to “Peruvian Poutine” in the Crowd-Pleaser round, and when Chef Rob Feenie’s ingredients come out, an unorthodox pairing of anchovies and honey has the Wall wondering if a home cook is swimming in troubled waters.

Jamie kicks things off by cooking up his Crazy Good Pork Burger—a naughty little treat that takes fast food to the next level. Then it’s sticky mango prawns, a speedy sharing platter with a shortcut to phenomenal flavor.

The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.
In the Capital of Weird, a diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, -  fried “chik’n” sandwiches, and Vietnamese “catfish”.
It’s time to go big or go home. Our dessert makers are challenged to push themselves to new heights and build a dessert structure that reaches a minimum height of half a metre.
On Jamie's menu is Asian sea bass, sticky rice, and dressed greens; plus chorizo carbonara and Catalan market salad.
Jenn visits northern Saskatchewan to learn how to catch, clean and cook walleye.
Fruit mousses are a staple in patisseries, and come in all sorts of colours and shapes. They can be a dessert on their own or part of a grand torte.
Pastry chefs are responsible for making their own ice cream in restaurants, and our creativity can really shine through.

The home cooks start out by preparing the dishes that made them famous in their own worlds, and Chef Daniela Manrique Lucca has everyone saying “Ooo, Mami!” when she reveals the contents of her fridge.

Jamie starts by cooking up his Tikka Chicken - it’s the quickest roast you’ll ever make. Next, there’s a vibrant carrot and grain salad you can whip up in minutes, and super speedy crab spaghetti—a luxurious and uncomplicated date night dinner.

Today Silvia explores how to make 3 meals that have actually become national treasures, like the 1000 year old recipe for Pasta Amatriciana, Plus a seafood dish from the Puglia region that is largely unknown to the outside world. And a pizza dish so cherished, its recipe is protected by the EU and the United Nations, Pizza Napoletana.

In Austin, Jess visits Leroy and Lewis Barbecue, where lesser-known cuts like top blade are given the spotlight. She then heads back to her own kitchen to show how home cooks can confidently tackle alternative cuts, unlocking big BBQ flavour without relying on the usual brisket.

In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.
Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare

Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.
Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programmes.t: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.
By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.
Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programmes.t: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
programmes.d: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.
Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.
A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programmes.t: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40

programmes.d: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programmes.d: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programmes.t: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.
Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.
In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programmes.d: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.
